items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Are there any other men that played with you later? ... Canna-lade, Daisy.

ctx.x: And that was the one of the Spanish-American war. That's it. Yeah. That's it. Yeah. Yeah. That's it. Are there any other men that played with you later? No. No. No. In the ragtime band? No. All of them.
The only one I know is Gosher.
